conceptual_change: Implement a deterministic order execution module that triggers a market buy order when the 50-period SMA crosses above the 200-period SMA and a market sell order when the 50-period SMA crosses below the 200-period SMA on the 1h timeframe.
rationale: The previous attempt was rejected due to a lack of an executable implementation. Defining the explicit signal-to-order mapping allows for the technical validation of the strategy within the execution engine as required by the failure analysis of BC 4.
